# ManifoldBasedFlexibility

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The property that neural manifolds can be smoothly deformed or reorganized to accommodate new tasks without catastrophic forgetting. Enables TCC systems to reuse existing computational substrates for multiple functions, enhancing scalability and adaptability in network-centric computing.
